lines.369680644502532096: Eddie Velvet. Mr. Jackman wants me to find him.
lines.369680644502532097: No one seems to be around.
lines.369680644527697922: What the hell is going on?

lines.369680644649332736: Sweet girl. What's there more to say? Good taste in music.
lines.369680644657721344:
The last time anyone saw Alice alive was when you took her up to the Peak. 
What were you doing up there?
lines.369680644661915648: Get real with me, Eddie. People saw you on the cable car.
lines.369680644661915649: I didn’t know we were trespassing.
lines.369680644661915650: You killed her somewhere up on that mountain, didn’t you?
lines.369680644666109952: Then you made up some bullshit story about a car ride that never happened.
lines.369680644666109953: Talk to me Eddie. What are my guys gonna find up there? Where did you put the body?
lines.369680644695470080: I'll show you. It's something really special.
lines.369680644716441600: A Ride to the stars, what's up there?
lines.369680644749996032: Everything about this place feels wrong.
lines.369680644749996033: But Eddie has stayed here, be a shame to turn back now.
lines.369680644770967552: Gusts of icy rain push me further into the desolate town.
lines.369680644775161856: Judging by the boarded up facades, most locals must have done the sensible thing and left before the storm.
lines.369680644796133376: The air smells of moldy pastries and stale coffee.
lines.369680644800327680: Outside I can hear the dogs barking. Dogs have always made me nervous.
lines.369680644821299200: The air is thick with mold and rot, and something else that I can’t put my finger on.
lines.369680644821299201: Something is off, and it’s not just the building.
lines.369680644846465024: I haven’t seen the inside of a church in years.
lines.369680644846465025: Didn’t think I’d ever see one again.
lines.369680644871630849: It looms over the park like a great dark shadow, renovations left midway, barely covered up.
lines.369680644871630850: People sure left Silver Pines in a hurry.
lines.369680644896796672: The air feels so much colder up here, like cold iron around my chest.
lines.369680644896796673: A voice in my head keeps saying this is crazy, that I should turn back...
lines.369680644900990976: After everything I've seen, I’m almost ready to listen to it.
lines.369680644917768192: I don't know what I can possibly expect to find in a place like this.
lines.369680644917768193: If this is where I'll find my mark, he sure picked one hell of a place to hole up.
lines.369680644942934016: Some girl Eddie was seeing? The picture's torn up.
